items.q: What determines your drive more than absolute dopamine?
items.a: Your experience of life and motivation depends on **how much dopamine you have relative to recent experience**. After a reward, dopamine drops **below** the pre-seeking level — addiction chases relief from depletion, not pleasure.

items.q: How big are common stimulus peaks?
items.a: Rough magnitudes: chocolate **~1.5×**, sex **~2×**, nicotine/cocaine **~2.5×**, amphetamine **~10×**, enjoyed exercise **~2×** — all relative to baseline.

items.q: Why should you avoid max dopamine every session?
items.a: **Intermittent** (variable) reinforcement preserves long-term motivation better than constant peaks — the casino/social-media pattern applied deliberately.

items.q: What is the cold-water paradox in this Essentials cut?
items.a: Unlike most peaks, cold immersion can raise baseline for hours at about **2.5×**. **Novelty required** — adaptation dulls the effect. Avoid extreme ~**30°F** shock for safety.

items.q: When should you spike dopamine relative to effort?
items.a: **Don't spike prior to or after effort.** Learn to spike dopamine **from effort itself** — trophy-focus extends time perception and drains in-activity pleasure.

items.q: Why is caffeine treated differently from other stimulants?
items.a: It **upregulates D2/D3** receptors. Yerba mate adds caffeine plus antioxidants, GLP-1 effects, and **dopamine-neuron neuroprotection**.

items.q: How should you use L-tyrosine or PEA if at all?
items.a: Keep supplements **episodic**: L-tyrosine **500–1000 mg** (peak ~**45 min**, then crash); **PEA 500 mg + Alpha-GPC 300 mg** for short focus bouts — avoid regular use.

items.q: Why do external rewards undermine intrinsic drive?
items.a: The Stanford gold-star study showed external rewards **dissociate pleasure from the activity**. Prefrontal reframing during friction builds reflexive, effort-based drive — the most powerful dopaminergic circuit Huberman highlights here.

sections.title: When to use this vs the full episode

items.q: What does this 33-minute Essentials omit from the masterclass?
items.a: It skips deeper **dopamine stacking**, the smartphone-at-gym rule, melatonin / **10 PM–4 AM** light warnings, Mucuna/huperzine A, the full **14-tool** list, and deeper Lembke pleasure-pain integration — use it as a quick pass before the **137-min** episode.
